title: Results Day
tagline: Joel's big email lands at noon. His two best friends pick today to start acting very strange.

p_gate.text:
Ashgrove High. A Friday in March, ten past eight. Cold enough to see your breath. Somebody's bike lock has frozen, and they're taking it personally.

Your phone says what it said at six. And at five. And at four.

*Northmoor University: decisions will be emailed at 12:00 today.*

Three years of wanting it. Three hours and fifty minutes to go.

[Joel: neutral] "Not that I'm counting."

Under it, a message from two minutes past five this morning.

*Leo: chocolate or vanilla. don't ask why*

You didn't ask why. You didn't answer, either. Sara got her place in January. Leo's got the bakery in September. Yours is the last one left.

So there's a rule, and Sara made all three of you shake on it: you don't open that email until everyone's at the table. It's a good rule. They're good friends.

They are about to be extremely weird.

choices.say: *I put the phone away. I check it once more on the stairs.*

p_class.text:
Room 12, before the bell. At the back, two people are bent over one desk, whispering.

[Sara: worried] "No, *gold*. I said gold. That's yellow."

[Leo: neutral] "In the right light, though..."

[Sara: angry] "What light, Leo? What light is that?"

[Leo: neutral] "...Candle?"

[Sara: determined] "That's a point to me. Forty-one to three."

She marks it down on the back page of her planner.

[Leo: neutral] "I dispute two of those."

[Joel: happy] "Morning."

Sara slams the planner shut. Leo sits down on a notebook. On it. Like a hen.

[Sara: surprised] "JOEL! Hi! You're here! At school!"

[Joel: neutral] "It's Friday. I go here."

[Leo: neutral] "He's got us there."

[Sara: happy] "Ha! So! Noon! Big day! You're not opening it early, right?"

[Joel: neutral] "You made us shake on it."

[Sara: happy] "We shook on it. We did. Great. Moving on!"

[Joel: neutral] "What's gold?"

[Leo: neutral] "Define gold."

[Sara: angry] "Don't define gold!"

She grabs his sleeve.

[Sara: worried] "Leo. The thing. We've got that thing."

[Leo: surprised] "Now? ...Oh. *Now.* Yeah. The thing with the—"

[Sara: angry] "Don't say what it's with!"

They leave at a speed you'd call a walk if you were being kind. Sara's tote bag is still on her chair. Wide open. Something inside it crackles.

choices.say: *It's open. It's practically looking at me.* "...One look."

p_corridor.text:
Break. The corridor smells of wet coats and somebody's orange.

Leo is heading for the far end with something long up the back of his jacket. A roll of paper sticks out of the collar, smeared with yellow paint.

[if peeked] Balloons in the bag. Paint on the paper. Theory one is holding up: a party, and not yours.

[Joel: neutral] "Leo."

[Leo: surprised] "...Joel! Mate."

[Joel: neutral] "What's in your jacket?"

[Leo: worried] "Poster."

[Joel: neutral] "What poster?"

[Leo: worried] "...Geography."

[Joel: neutral] "You dropped geography."

[Leo: neutral] "And look how much I miss it."

Boots on the floor behind you, closing in.

[Sara: angry] "LEO! There you are! We're late for choir!"

[Leo: surprised] "For what?"

[Sara: angry] "Choir. I told you to say choir."

[Leo: neutral] "I said geography."

[Sara: worried] "Why would you say geography?"

[Leo: neutral] "Why would I say choir? I can't sing."

[Sara: angry] "Nobody was going to make you sing! It's a cover st—"

They've forgotten you're here. It's almost restful.

[Joel: neutral] "I'm right here."

[Sara: surprised] "..."

[Leo: neutral] "He's right there, Sar."

choices.say: *Whispering. Sneaking off. There's one obvious answer.* "Are you two... dating?"
*Say it plainly.* "Are you two avoiding me?"

p_lunch.text:
Noon. The table by the window, same as always. One seat has your bag on it. One has your coat. Neither has a friend.

Then every phone in the canteen goes off at once.

"I got in! Mum! I got in!"

"'Waiting list'? Waiting for *what*?"

Yours is face up on the table.

*Northmoor University: Your application decision*

It just sits there. Bold. Unread.

Buzz.

*Sara: RUNNING LATE!! do NOT open it!!!*

*Leo: what she said*

*Leo: save the seats*

[Joel: worried] "Late from *where*?"

The seats don't know either.

choices.say: *Three years. I'm not waiting on two empty chairs.* "Sorry, Sara."

i_artroom.text:
The art room, ten past one. Officially, two people are at the dentist.

Sara is standing on a chair with a roll of tape on her wrist like a bangle. Leo has one end of a paper banner and a cake box.

[Sara: worried] "Higher. No, your end. *Your* end, Leo."

[Leo: neutral] "I've only got the one end."

[Sara: angry] "We missed noon! We *shook* on noon!"

[Leo: neutral] "The cake was in the bakery fridge. You want a party with no cake?"

[Sara: worried] "I want a party where we know if he got in!"

[Leo: neutral] "So text him."

[Sara: angry] "And say what? 'Did you get in, no reason'?"

[if peeked] [Leo: neutral] "He's seen the balloons anyway."

[if peeked] [Sara: worried] "He went through my bag! He knows!"

[if peeked] [Leo: neutral] "He thinks you're thinking about art. We're fine."

[if said_dating] [Sara: angry] "And now he thinks we're dating."

[if said_dating] [Leo: neutral] "You told him. 'Very in love.' I was there."

[if said_dating] [Sara: angry] "I panicked! It was that or choir!"

She gets down off the chair. She looks at the banner for a while.

[Sara: worried] "...What if it's a no? It says congratulations. In gold. We can't just..."

[Leo: neutral] "About that..."

He turns his end over. There's more paint on the back.

[Sara: surprised] "What is that?"

[Leo: neutral] "Plan B."

[Sara: surprised] "'UNIVERSITY IS A SCAM ANYWAY.'"

[Leo: happy] "Heh. Double-sided. There's a cord."

[Sara: angry] "You made a *sad side*?"

[Leo: neutral] "I made a realistic side."

[Sara: worried] "...Is there a waiting-list side?"

[Leo: neutral] "It's a banner, Sar. It's got two."

She opens her planner at the back page and, with great reluctance, gives him a point. Sara 41. Leo 4.

p_last.text:
Last period, Room 12. Ten to three. Two desks have been empty since lunch. Mr. Okoro reads the afternoon register without looking up.

"Quinn and Vance are at the dentist. The same dentist. I'm told it's urgent."

[if opened] You got into Northmoor three hours ago. So far you've told a first-year and a table.

[if !opened] The email is still unread in your pocket. It weighs about as much as a brick.

There's a folded note on your desk. It wasn't there this morning.

*JOEL MERCER is REQUIRED in the ART ROOM after final bell. This is official. — The School*

It's Leo's handwriting. Under *The School* you can still read where he signed it *Leo* and crossed it out.

[if said_dating] *P.S. We are NOT dating. — L (The School)*

[Joel: neutral] "'The School.'"

"Something to share, Mercer?"

[Joel: embarrassed] "No, sir. Just..."

[Joel: embarrassed] "Worried about their teeth."

Theory four: an intervention. Theory five: a cult. You spend the whole lesson on theory six. The bell goes before you finish it.

choices.say: *I take the note and go downstairs, past the lockers, all the way to the end.*

p_door.text:
The far end of the corridor. Past the last locker there's one door, and in three years you've never had a reason to open it.

The lights are off inside. It isn't a quiet dark. It's the kind with people in it.

"Shh!"

"You shh."

"Is it the right way round? Because if it isn't—"

"Which way's the right way?"

"WE DON'T KNOW YET, LEO."

[Joel: neutral] "..."

Something falls over in there. Somebody apologises to it.

[if opened] Three and a half hours of good news, and you haven't told anyone who matters.

[if !opened] Three and a half hours, and the email in your hand is still unopened.

[Joel: determined] "Right."

You knock once, because you were raised properly.

p_party.text:
The lights slam on.

[cg surprise]

[Sara: happy] "SURPRISE!"

[Leo: happy] "Surprise."

The popper goes off like a small cannon. Streamers land on Leo. He doesn't blink.

[cg off]

A banner in yellow paint that's gold in the right light. Balloons everywhere. A cake with your name on it.

[Joel: surprised] "...This is the thing? *This* was the thing?"

[Sara: happy] "All day! We've been lying to you ALL DAY!"

[Leo: neutral] "Badly."

[Sara: happy] "So badly! Congratulations, Joel!"

[Joel: surprised] "For what?"

A silence. Sara looks at Leo. Leo looks at the banner.

[Sara: worried] "For... getting in?"

[Leo: worried] "You did get in. Tell her you..."

[Sara: worried] "We don't actually know. We missed noon."

[Leo: neutral] "There was a cake emergency."

Two friends, one banner, and a cord in Leo's hand you hadn't noticed until now.

p_knew.text:
You know. They don't. For the first time today, you're the one with the secret.

[Sara: worried] "Joel?"

[Leo: worried] "Mate. Say something. Anything. Even if it's..."

His hand tightens on the cord.

choices.say: *I look at the floor. I let my shoulders drop.* "...About that."
*I can't. I've been holding it for three hours.* "I GOT IN!"

p_open.text:
[Joel: neutral] "I don't know either."

[Sara: surprised] "...What?"

[Joel: neutral] "We shook on it. All three of us, you said."

You hold up the phone. One email. Not opened.

[Sara: surprised] "You *waited*? I mean, I said to, but— who actually waits?"

[Leo: neutral] "Not me."

[Sara: angry] "You opened your exam results in the car park."

[Leo: neutral] "And I've made my peace with them."

[Joel: worried] "Can we just— now? Please. Before I..."

[cg phone]

Three heads. One screen. Sara has hold of your sleeve and doesn't know it.

*Dear Joel, we are delighted to offer you a place—*

[Sara: happy] "DELIGHTED! THEY'RE DELIGHTED!"

[Leo: happy] "Heh. Never doubted it."

[Joel: happy] "I got in."

It's quieter than you thought it would be, saying it. It's better.

[cg off]

Behind Sara, Leo unhooks a cord from the banner and puts it in his pocket, very casually.

[Joel: neutral] "What's the cord for?"

[Sara: happy] "Nothing!"

[Leo: neutral] "Nothing."

There's more paint on the back of that banner. You decide you can live without knowing.

p_cake.text:
The cake is half chocolate, half vanilla, with a line down the middle. Leo cuts it with a palette knife.

[Leo: neutral] "You never answered the text."

[Joel: happy] "Wait. This is actually good."

[Leo: neutral] "Why 'actually'?"

[Sara: happy] "He was at the bakery at five. Don't tell him it's good, he'll get ideas."

[Leo: happy] "Too late."

[Sara: happy] "Right. Confessions. Everybody."

[if peeked] [Joel: neutral] "I looked in your bag."

[if peeked] [Sara: angry] "I *know* you looked in my bag."

[if peeked] [Joel: neutral] "I thought you were having a party without me."

[if peeked] [Leo: neutral] "We were. All day. It was mostly tape."

[if !peeked] [Joel: neutral] "I didn't look in your bag."

[if !peeked] [Sara: worried] "I know! It was open for *ages*. Who does that?"

[if !peeked] [Leo: neutral] "He's polite."

[if !peeked] [Sara: angry] "It's not natural."

[if said_dating] [Joel: neutral] "And you two aren't dating."

[if said_dating] [Leo: neutral] "For the record. No."

[if said_dating] [Sara: angry] "You don't have to say it like *that*."

[if !said_dating] [Joel: embarrassed] "I thought it was me. That you were sick of me, or..."

[if !said_dating] [Sara: surprised] "Of *you*? We invented a dentist for you!"

[if !said_dating] [Leo: neutral] "Same dentist. Rookie mistake."

[if opened] [Joel: embarrassed] "I told a first-year before I told you."

[if opened] [Leo: neutral] "Fair."

[if opened] [Joel: embarrassed] "And a table."

[if opened] [Sara: happy] "Ha! A *table*!"

[if !opened] [Joel: neutral] "And you two broke the rule. I didn't."

[if !opened] [Leo: neutral] "Cake emergency."

[if !opened] [Sara: angry] "Stop calling it that."

[if bluffed] [Leo: happy] "The ten seconds, though. That's a point to Joel."

[if bluffed] [Sara: angry] "He is *not* going on the board."

[cg cake]

The balloons have started coming down on their own. Nobody picks them up.

[Sara: happy] "Read it again."

[Joel: embarrassed] "Sara. You've seen it. I can't just..."

[Sara: happy] "Out loud. From 'delighted'."

[Leo: neutral] "Do the voice."

[Joel: happy] "There's no voice."

[Leo: happy] "Heh. There's a voice."

You read it again. From delighted. You do the voice. Theory seven: you've got good friends. Terrible liars. Good friends.

p_class_r0.text:
A pack of balloons. Forty, gold and white. Three rolls of tape. One party popper the size of a wine bottle.

[Joel: surprised] "...Forty?"

Footsteps in the corridor. Fast ones.

[Sara: surprised] "That's not— that's my—"

[Sara: angry] "That's my bag!"

[Joel: neutral] "Why do you need forty balloons?"

[Sara: worried] "Art. They're for art. It's a sculpture. A balloon... sculpture."

[Joel: neutral] "You don't take art."

[Sara: determined] "I'm thinking about it. I'm thinking about it very hard."

She leaves with the bag held against her chest like a baby. Theory one: somebody's having a party. And nobody's told you.

choices.text: Go to your locker at break
choices.say: *Two lessons. They slide in late to both and leave early. At break I head down to my locker.*

p_class_r1.text:
You sit on your hands. The bag crackles again. You study the ceiling. Footsteps in the corridor. Fast ones.

[Sara: worried] "My bag! I left my—"

She looks at the bag. She looks at you.

[Sara: surprised] "...You didn't look?"

[Joel: neutral] "Should I have?"

[Sara: happy] "No! Good! That's good. That's very..."

[Sara: worried] "It was open for *ages*, Joel. Who doesn't look?"

[Joel: neutral] "Me, apparently."

She takes it and goes. She seems almost hurt. Theory one: you've just failed a test you didn't know you were sitting.

choices.text: Go to your locker at break
choices.say: *Two lessons. They slide in late to both and leave early. At break I head down to my locker.*

p_corridor_r0.text:
[Sara: surprised] "HIM?"

[Leo: surprised] "Her?"

[Sara: angry] "What do you mean, *her*?"

[Leo: neutral] "What do you mean, *him*?"

A pause. You can see Sara thinking. It's like watching someone reverse a van.

[Sara: determined] "...Yes."

[Leo: surprised] "Yes?"

[Sara: determined] "Yes. We're dating. That's the secret. You got us."

[Leo: worried] "Do I get a say in—"

[Sara: happy] "We're very in love. Bye, Joel! Noon!"

She tows him off by the sleeve. The poster bends in the middle. Theory two: they're not dating. Nobody in love has ever looked that annoyed.

choices.text: Go and save the table for noon
choices.say: *The lunch bell. I'm first into the canteen: bag on one seat, coat on the other.*

p_corridor_r1.text:
[Sara: surprised] "Avoiding? Us? You?"

[Leo: neutral] "We're talking to you now, mate."

[Sara: happy] "Right now! Talking! Look at us go!"

They are both walking backwards.

[Joel: neutral] "You're leaving. While you say it."

[Leo: neutral] "Not leaving. Just, you know..."

[Sara: worried] "Noon! We'll be there at noon! Save the seats!"

[Leo: neutral] "Both seats."

They back round the corner. Something hits a locker.

"Ow."

Theory two: it's you. You smell, or you're boring. Possibly both.

choices.text: Go and save the table for noon
choices.say: *The lunch bell. I'm first into the canteen: bag on one seat, coat on the other.*

p_lunch_r0.text:
You open it.

*Dear Joel, we are delighted to offer you a place—*

You read it four times. It says the same thing every time.

[Joel: surprised] "I got in."

Nobody. A bag and a coat.

[Joel: happy] "I got in! I actually—"

A first-year with a tray stops and stares at you.

"...Congrats?"

[Joel: happy] "Thank you. Thank you so much."

He leaves quickly. You type *I GOT IN* into the group chat. You delete it. Some things you say to a face.

Lunch ends. No faces. Theory three: you'll kill them, and then you'll tell them.

p_lunch_r1.text:
You turn the phone face down. You turn it back over. Face down. Five minutes. Then ten.

[Joel: neutral] "They're coming. They said noon. They said..."

The notification is glowing through the back of the phone. You're sure of it. A first-year with a tray stops beside you.

"Are those seats taken?"

[Joel: determined] "Yes."

"Who by?"

[Joel: worried] "...Good question."

Your chips go cold. The bell goes. Nobody comes. Theory three: they've been kidnapped. It's the only excuse you'll accept.

p_knew_r0.text:
[Sara: sad] "Oh. Oh, Joel..."

[Leo: neutral] "Plan B."

He pulls the cord.

[cg flip]

The banner turns over. There's more paint on the back.

*UNIVERSITY IS A SCAM ANYWAY*

[Joel: surprised] "...You *planned* for this?"

[Leo: neutral] "Somebody had to."

[Sara: sad] "It doesn't matter! We don't care! You're still—"

[Joel: happy] "I got in."

[cg off]

[Sara: surprised] "..."

[Sara: happy] "HE GOT IN! Leo! Turn it back! Turn it back!"

Leo pulls the cord again. Congratulations comes round. Then she hits you on the arm.

[Sara: angry] "TEN SECONDS! You let me be sad for ten whole seconds!"

[Joel: happy] "You let me eat lunch with a coat."

[Leo: happy] "Heh. He's got us there."

[Sara: happy] "Show me. I want to see it. The actual words."

You hold out the phone. She reads it with her nose almost on the screen.

[Sara: happy] "'Delighted'! Leo! They're *delighted*!"

[Leo: happy] "So they should be."

p_knew_r1.text:
[Sara: surprised] "..."

[Sara: happy] "HE GOT IN! LEO! HE GOT IN!"

[Leo: happy] "I heard. I'm a metre away."

She hits you at about chest height. Technically it's a hug.

[Joel: happy] "I opened it at lunch. Sorry. You weren't there, and I just..."

[Sara: happy] "I don't care! I care a bit! I don't care! Show me!"

You hold out the phone. She reads it with her nose almost on the screen.

[Sara: happy] "'Delighted'! Leo! They're *delighted*!"

[Leo: happy] "So they should be."

He lets go of the cord and puts that hand in his pocket, very casually.

[Joel: neutral] "What's the cord for?"

[Leo: neutral] "What cord?"

[Sara: happy] "Ha! Go on. Show him your *realistic side*."

He sighs and pulls it. The banner turns over. There's more paint on the back.

*UNIVERSITY IS A SCAM ANYWAY*

[Joel: happy] "...Can I keep that side?"

[Leo: happy] "Heh. No."

He pulls the cord again. Congratulations comes back round.
